summary: This bill requires political committees to file separate reports for contributions of $1,000 or more received fewer than 20 days before an election if the committee makes contributions or expenditures in that election, aiming to increase transparency in election funding.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to require more frequent and specific reporting of large campaign contributions close to an election. Its primary purpose is to increase transparency in election financing, which is a core aspect of election reform.
